LanguageData.SDS_BuildingCore.label: Super Dimensional Core
LanguageData.SDS_BuildingCore.description: The core device that anchors super dimensional space. Only after super dimensional space is anchored can colonists use it.
LanguageData.SDS_BuildingCapacityArray.label: Super Dimensional Stabilizer
LanguageData.SDS_BuildingCapacityArray.description: An advanced device that stabilizes super dimensional space. Once stabilized, it raises the capacity of super dimensional space, and multiple devices stack without limit.
LanguageData.SDS_BuildingPort.label: Super Dimensional Anchor
LanguageData.SDS_BuildingPort.description: A basic device that connects to super dimensional space. Once connected, colonists can store and withdraw super dimensional stock here; its power draw is far lower than the core, so it can be deployed throughout the colony.
LanguageData.SDS_HiddenVault.label: Super Dimensional Vault
LanguageData.SDS_HiddenVault.description: Hidden vault that stores the physical mirrors. Invisible, unselectable, undeconstructible and does not block movement.
